description: Revert to the proven 8-layer/128-head-dim architecture with Device Batch Size 128 (maximizing H200 VRAM usage to reduce gradient noise), and fine-tune the Matrix Learning Rate to 0.038 and Weight Decay to 0.19 to find a slightly more stable convergence point than the previous 0.9917 attempt, aiming to beat the 0.9915 baseline.
